categories.main_business_segments: Fujian Yuanli Active Carbon Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the chemical raw materials and chemical products manufacturing industry, focusing on the research, production, and sales of activated carbon, sodium silicate, and silica gel. The company also engages in the development of new energy carbon materials and clean energy solutions, with business segments including activated carbon, silicate products, and energy-related products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced continuous, clean, and automated production technologies for activated carbon, sodium silicate, and silica gel. It holds numerous patents, including 59 for activated carbon and several for silicate and silica gel products. Key technologies include large-scale phosphoric acid method for clean production of activated carbon, high-pressure electric field technology for gas pollutant removal, and integrated heat energy recycling in production processes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Yuanli serves diverse industries such as food and beverage, pharmaceuticals, chemical industry, water treatment, air purification, metallurgy, white carbon black, silicone rubber, and new energy sectors like power batteries and energy storage. Its products are sold domestically across most provinces and exported to Asia, Europe, and other regions, catering to both traditional and emerging markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Fujian (Nanping, Putian), Jiangxi (Yushan), Inner Mongolia (Manzhouli), Liaoning (Panjin), and Shanghai. It serves both domestic and international markets, with about 16% of revenue from overseas sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: Fujian Yuanli is positioned upstream to midstream in the supply chain, producing raw and processed chemical materials such as activated carbon, sodium silicate, and silica gel. It integrates raw material sourcing, production, and downstream product development, including new energy carbon materials, and operates a circular industrial park to enhance resource recycling and energy efficiency.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technology innovation as its core strategy, focusing on R&D for high-performance activated carbon, new energy carbon materials like supercapacitor carbon, biomass hard carbon, and porous carbon. It invests in clean production technologies, energy recycling, and expanding product applications in environmental protection, pharmaceuticals, and new energy sectors. Yuanli also pursues industrial chain integration and capacity expansion through ongoing projects.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of chemical products including activated carbon, sodium silicate, and silica gel. The company uses a direct sales model supplemented by distribution channels. It also gains income from investment returns and government subsidies related to its green and innovative initiatives.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yuanli is a leading domestic player and industry leader in wood-based activated carbon production in China, with the largest production and sales volume nationally. It competes with other large domestic and international companies, particularly those in the US, Japan, and Europe. Its technological and scale advantages position it ahead of many smaller domestic competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.88 billion, a slight decline of 6.57% from the previous year, but net profit attributable to shareholders increased by 19.95% to RMB 284 million. It has total assets of about RMB 4 billion and continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D, showing a stable growth trajectory with improving profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yuanli emphasizes its advanced technology, large-scale and clean production processes, and comprehensive product portfolio covering various types of activated carbon and silicate products. Its integrated circular industrial park enhances cost efficiency and environmental sustainability. The company’s strong R&D capabilities and patented technologies enable it to offer high-quality, low-cost products with expanding applications in traditional and emerging sectors such as new energy storage and pharmaceuticals.
